title: Mapping — component (mapping-component, formatVersion 1, 2, 3 and 4)
description: Validates only the structure of the component file. The source of truth is the code (src/model/components/parseComponent.ts), which also checks what the schema does not see: fields cited by the expressions that exist in the specialization's type, minSize not greater than size, the template root being required to be of type frame, the single slot, and the drawing proof. See COMPONENT-FORMAT.md. The repeat node (the drawn table) is valid from formatVersion 2: in formatVersion 1 it is a parseComponent error; the repeat cannot have a repeat or slot inside it, and the schema does not check that the cited field is a table of the type. The image node (remote image) exists only in formatVersion 3: in a 1 or 2 it is a parseComponent error; the schema checks that src is an https:// literal or exactly {"$field"}, but not that the bound field is of type string nor the full shape of the URL (no username and password, up to 2048 characters). formatVersion 4 adds rotation (any node except the root, which the schema does not check: that is parseComponent's job; degrees, clockwise, around the center of the box, drawing only), stroke.cap, stroke.join and stroke.sides, minWidth, maxWidth, minHeight and maxHeight (any node), repeat.distribute and an expression in width, height, layout.type, layout.align and layout.justify (in a lower version it is a parseComponent error; the literal in those five keys is valid in all versions). The schema does not check that minWidth is not greater than maxWidth. formatVersion 4 also adds stroke.offset (frame, rect and ellipse), stroke.dash by expression, $token in shadow.x, shadow.y and shadow.blur and in each item of cornerRadius and of stroke.dash, layout.justify space-around and space-evenly, layout.reverse and alpha in the color $token (the schema does not check the version nor the type of the position: that is parseComponent's job). formatVersion 4 also adds stroke.gap (frame and rect, without sides; the cited node must exist in the template, which the schema does not check), shadow as a list of 1 to 4 shadows and shadow.spread (the schema does not check the version: that is parseComponent's job). formatVersion 4 also adds font.align justify, over in the color $token (the color composited over another, opaque) and the image fit values fill-width, fill-height, scale-down and none (the schema does not check the version nor the position: that is parseComponent's job). formatVersion 4 also accepts { "$token": "name" } where a color, number or font family is expected (the schema leaves the expression in keys of a compatible type, but does not check the position nor that the token exists in the specialization's tokens: that is the job of parseComponent and validate_library). formatVersion 4 also adds layout.wrap, layout.lineGap, layout.maxPerLine and layout.maxLines (frame and slot) and wrap, lineGap, maxPerLine and maxLines in the repeat (the row break; the schema does not check the version nor that lineGap, maxPerLine and maxLines are valid only with wrap: that is parseComponent's job). formatVersion 4 also adds align and justify in the none layout (start, center, end or stretch, literal or expression), clip on the slot and clip of the frame by expression (the schema does not check the version: that is parseComponent's job). formatVersion 4 also adds provide on the slot (name → text or number expression, resolved in the parent) and { "$provided": "name", "default": … } in expressions (the color inherited from the nearest ancestor that offers the name; valid only in a color position, which the schema does not check; the schema does not check the version nor the src of the image, which remains only literal or $field: that is parseComponent's job). formatVersion 4 also adds variables: let on the frame (name → expression, valid in the frame and in the descendants) and { "$var": "name" } where an expression or condition is valid (the schema checks the name and the shape, not that the variable exists, the cycle, nor the type of the content at the place of use: that is parseComponent's job).

screen.description: formatVersion 4, root only. The template is drawn at the component's size in screen pixels, at any zoom, anchored at the anchor point (default center) of the marking's rectangle; the drawing may extend beyond the rectangle (without the 'does not fit' pending item). In a lower formatVersion parseComponent refuses with 'only allowed with formatVersion 4'.

offset.description: In component units (the container's density converts them to pixels). When absent they are 0.

anchor.description: formatVersion 4, root only. How the type prefers to sit against a marking's anchor: side (default top), align (default center) and offset (default 0, 0). All optional. In a lower formatVersion parseComponent refuses with 'only allowed with formatVersion 4'.

anyOf.description: Rows of a table field (formatVersion 2, repeat node): one column per key.

size_noHug.description: Size of the image node: px, "fill" or "NN%" (hug is an error, the layout does not depend on the downloaded image).

sizing.description: Sizing without a rectangle. Each axis: px (>= 0), "fill", "hug", "min-content", "max-content" (formatVersion 4) or, in formatVersion 4, an expression that yields one of them, evaluated with the instance's values ($size and $lines are not valid here; parseComponent refuses % and $token).

anchors.description: Anchors in the parent with layout none. In formatVersion 4 each value can be an expression (centerX and centerY accept conditions); one that does not produce a number counts as an absent anchor. An expression in a version earlier than 4 is refused by parseComponent. In formatVersion 4, start and end are the logical anchors of the horizontal axis (start is the left in ltr and the right in rtl); start together with left, and end together with right, are refused by parseComponent.

offset.description: Offset of the stroke from the shape, in px (formatVersion 4, only in frame, rect and ellipse).

scale.description: true (default): the width scales with the zoom; false: the width is in screen pixels, at any zoom.

gap.description: The interrupted outline over the box of a template node (formatVersion 4; only in frame and rect, and not together with sides: parseComponent checks it, the schema does not). node is the name of a template node (the default is its type); padding (default 0) is the clearance on each side of the covered stretch.

stroke.description: cap, join, sides, scale, offset and gap exist only in formatVersion 4, and so does the expression in dash (the literal list is valid in all) (in a 1, 2 or 3 parseComponent refuses with 'only allowed with formatVersion 4'). sides is valid only in frame and rect (in ellipse and path it is a parseComponent error, which the schema does not check).

shadow.description: One shadow (object) or, in formatVersion 4, a list of 1 to 4 shadows (the first sits on top, like CSS box-shadow). The list in a lower version is a parseComponent error ('only allowed with formatVersion 4', at the path of shadow); the schema does not check the version. Only frame, rect and ellipse draw the whole list and the spread: in the other types only the first shadow applies.

spread.description: How much the shadow shape grows (or shrinks, if negative) on each side, in px (formatVersion 4; only in frame, rect and ellipse).

shadow_item.description: x, y, blur and spread accept a number { "$token": "name" } in formatVersion 4. The spread exists only in formatVersion 4 (in a lower version parseComponent refuses with 'only allowed with formatVersion 4').

wrap.description: formatVersion 4. word (default) breaks by word; none is one line per paragraph.

ellipsis.description: formatVersion 4. Text that does not fit (in the width with wrap none, or beyond maxLines) ends in …

maxLines.description: formatVersion 4. Integer greater than or equal to 1; the last allowed line gets the … (with ellipsis) or is cut off.

run.description: formatVersion 4. A stretch of the rich text (runs): it wraps together with the others as a single text. weight, italic, family, size and decoration override the node's font; color overrides the node's color. With background the stretch is an unbreakable inline box (chip), with radius and padding.

background.description: Background color of the inline box; none = no box.

layout.description: Distribution of the children: none (anchors), row, column or grid. In formatVersion 4, type, align and justify accept an expression, justify also space-around and space-evenly, reverse inverts the order of the children on the main axis (the start becomes the end) and wrap (none, wrap or wrap-reverse), lineGap, maxPerLine and maxLines break the row into lines (lineGap, maxPerLine and maxLines are valid only with wrap, which the schema does not check: that is parseComponent's job); with literal type "grid" (formatVersion 4; the schema does not check the version nor that exactly one of the four tracks columns, minColumnWidth, rows and minRowHeight is present (or several, when all are expressions and of the same orientation: the first that has a value wins), nor that the track keys are valid only in grid: that is parseComponent's job) gap, lineGap, padding, align and justify (start, center, end or stretch, within the cell), reverse and one track are valid: columns and rows (integer greater than or equal to 1) or minColumnWidth and minRowHeight (number greater than 0); wrap, maxPerLine and maxLines are not valid in the grid; with literal type "none" only type, align and justify are valid (formatVersion 4; align is the vertical axis and justify the horizontal one, with start, center, end or stretch; the schema does not check the version: that is parseComponent's job).

let.description: formatVersion 4: the frame's variables, name → expression (any value that fits where the variable is used). They are valid in the frame's keys and in those of the descendants (including the template of a repeat); the inner let hides the outer one. Use with { "$var": "name" }. parseComponent replaces the $var with the content and returns the frame without let; an unused variable is not checked. In a lower formatVersion, or on a node that is not a frame, parseComponent refuses.

direction.description: formatVersion 4: fixes the reading direction of the subtree (literal ltr or rtl, never an expression). The node is placed by the parent in the parent's direction; what is inside follows the one it fixes. In the repeat the direction key is a different one (the stacking of the rows). In a lower formatVersion, parseComponent refuses.

span.description: formatVersion 4: how many tracks the child occupies in a grid (integer greater than or equal to 1, default 1); the literal is valid only on a child of a grid layout, which the schema does not check: that is parseComponent's job.

weight.description: formatVersion 4: weight of the fill child on the main axis of row or column (number greater than 0, default 1); what is left over is divided in proportion to the weights. The literal is valid only on a fill child on the main axis, which the schema does not check: that is parseComponent's job.

clip.description: formatVersion 4, default false: the child markings drawn inside the slot are clipped by the slot's box (boolean or expression; the schema does not check the version: that is parseComponent's job).

provide.description: Colors or values that the slot offers to the child markings (formatVersion 4): free, non-empty name (the schema does not check the empty name: that is parseComponent's job) → text or number expression, resolved in the parent. Only on the slot. The child reads with { "$provided": "name", "default": … }.

node_icon.description: formatVersion 4. Icon from the library's set (icons of the specialization, formatVersion 15). The name is the name of the icon in the set (literal or expression; there is no node name here). color paints the paths without their own color and those that ask for the node's color (fill/stroke true); strokeWidth (viewBox units) replaces the stroke width. hug measures the icon's viewBox. A name outside the set: reserved with the unknown icon notice; a literal outside the set is a library validator error.

node_repeat.description: formatVersion 2. Repeats the template (the drawing of one row) per row of the type's table field. Inside the template, $field/$has/$eq/$switch read the row's column, which shadows the type's field of the same name. Frame hug on the rows' axis and fill on the other. With count (formatVersion 4) the template repeats by count, without a table field.

span.description: formatVersion 4: how many tracks the child occupies in a grid (integer greater than or equal to 1, default 1); the literal is valid only on a child of a grid layout, which the schema does not check: that is parseComponent's job.

weight.description: formatVersion 4: weight of the fill child on the main axis of row or column (number greater than 0, default 1); what is left over is divided in proportion to the weights. The literal is valid only on a fill child on the main axis, which the schema does not check: that is parseComponent's job.

layout.description: formatVersion 4: the full layout of the generated frame (row, column or grid) in place of direction and gap; it does not combine with direction or gap, and distribute fill is not valid with grid (the schema does not check: that is parseComponent's job).

distribute.description: formatVersion 4: "fill" makes the repeat occupy the parent's axis and divide the rows' axis equally (minus the gaps); "none" (default) is hug on the rows' axis. Literal only.

count.description: formatVersion 4: the template repeats max(0, floor(count)) times, up to 1000 (above that, 1000 rows with the notice "repeat limited to 1000 rows: <node>"); a negative or non-integer literal is refused by parseComponent. Inside the template, { "$field": "$index" } is the row index (0, 1, …), also in the repeat by field. Exactly one of field and count.

lit_sides.description: Non-empty list of sides. The absence of repetition is checked by parseComponent, not by the schema.

tokenRef.description: A number { "$token": "name" } (formatVersion 4), in positions that used to be literal only.

tokenName.description: Name of a token of the specialization (specialization formatVersion 15; component formatVersion 4).

operand.description: Operand of an operation or comparison (formatVersion 4): number, $field, $token, another operation, $if or $switch.

numericOps.description: Numeric operations (formatVersion 4): $add, $sub, $mul, $div, $mod, $round, $floor, $ceil, $abs, $min, $max, $clamp, $sin and $cos (in degrees). An operand with no value (empty, non-numeric text, division by zero) makes the operation produce no value. $rows (number of rows of a table field; with no rows, 0), $size ("width" or "height" of the instance in image px; in the drawing proof and in hug, the component's size) and $lines (the number of measured lines of a text node) also produce a number.

$lines.description: Name of a unique text node of the template: its number of measured lines (at most maxLines; empty text, 0). The engine lays out in two passes (formatVersion 4).

provide_value.description: Value of a provide: text or number expression, or color ($token of a color, with alpha and over).

varRef.description: Reference to a variable (formatVersion 4): { "$var": "name" } is valid where an expression or condition is valid and is replaced, on reading, by the content of the let of the frame (or of an ancestor) that defines it. The name is checked by the schema; that the variable exists, that there is no cycle and the type of the content at the place of use are parseComponent's job.
